Construction Services in Andover, KS

Andover is one of Butler County's fastest-growing communities — a city of roughly 15,000 residents straddling the Sedgwick-Butler County line east of Wichita. The housing stock runs predominantly from the 1990s through the 2010s, with major growth phases in the Wheatland Hills, Meadowbrook, and Summerfield subdivisions. That concentrated development window means most Andover homes are aging into renovation territory at roughly the same time — and Wheatland Construction is positioned to handle all of it.

We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, family-owned and faith-forward since 2018. Our office is in El Dorado — Butler County is our home market. We serve Andover regularly and we know the housing stock, the permit offices, and the soil conditions specific to this area.

What We Build in Andover

Custom Homes

Andover has active residential development in the areas east of 159th Street and along the US-400/US-54 corridor. We build custom homes in Andover on client-owned lots, handling architecture coordination, permitting through Butler County or the City of Andover, and all construction from foundation to finish. See Custom Home Building in Andover →

Home Additions

Andover's 1990s and 2000s homes were built for growing families — and a lot of those families have outgrown them. Room additions, master suite expansions, garage conversions, and sunrooms are common scopes in Andover's established subdivisions. We match existing rooflines and finishes so the addition looks like it was always there. See Home Additions in Andover →

Basement Finishing

The newer poured-concrete basements in Andover's major growth-era subdivisions are ideal candidates for finishing — good foundation integrity, code-compliant rough-in spacing, and enough square footage to add a bedroom, bathroom, and family room in one scope. We assess moisture conditions first and handle all permits through Butler County or the City of Andover. See Basement Finishing in Andover →

Bathroom Remodeling

Andover's builder-grade bathrooms from the 1990s and 2000s are reaching the end of their useful life — fiberglass surrounds that have yellowed and crazed, cultured marble vanity tops with cracks, tile set with grout that's been failing for 15 years. We replace all of it: new shower or tub surround, new vanity and countertop, new tile, new fixtures, proper exhaust ventilation. See Bathroom Remodeling in Andover →

Kitchen Remodeling

Andover kitchens from the subdivision buildout era have laminate countertops that have swelled at seams, builder-grade cabinet boxes that are delaminating at the toe-kick, and lighting layouts that weren't designed for how kitchens actually get used. We remodel Andover kitchens from layout reconfiguration through cabinet replacement, countertops, backsplash, and appliance placement. See Kitchen Remodeling in Andover →

Major Remodels

Some Andover projects are bigger than a single room — whole-floor renovations, primary suite expansions, or layout changes that require structural work. We handle major remodels that involve multiple trades, permit coordination, and extended timelines. See Major Remodels in Andover →

Roofing

Butler County's hail exposure is significant — Andover has taken multiple hail events serious enough to qualify for insurance claims. We install new roofs in Andover using material systems appropriate for the Kansas climate, handle insurance coordination when applicable, and pull all required permits. See Roofing in Andover →

Andover's Permit Offices

Andover has a split jurisdiction. Homes inside city limits permit through the City of Andover Building Inspection Division. Homes in unincorporated Butler County — which covers much of the eastern Andover area beyond city limits — permit through Butler County. We determine the right jurisdiction for your address and handle all applications and inspections.
